categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC validation in blockchain.cpp for the dumptxoutset method.
categories.rationale: Fixes a daemon assertion crash caused by invoking the `dumptxoutset` RPC with `rollback` on a pruned node after `loadtxoutset`. Returning an RPC error prevents an unhandled abort, resolving a concrete reliability issue when interacting with assumeutxo.
